title: CR-BRK-003 — Tech View vs See Financial — triple pricing leak on line form
preconds: WO V \u2713 | WO Lines E \u2713 | View Mode: Tech | See Financial \u2713 | Catalog & Inv V \u2713 | Parts Dept \u2713 | Invoicing V \u2713 (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.

expected: Tech is able to see Labor Rate among other financial info since See Financial Data permissions will override Tech View permission.
